queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM per_type WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per_type)

WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.avg_bytes_per_ms DESC

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM per_type WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per_type)

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 are not a concern (Milliseconds is a required duration; no zero-handling added). Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division. Media types with no tracks above the threshold are excluded from the overall average.
Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId and name (names are assumed unique in practice).

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.avg_bytes_per_ms DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each media type's average is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds (not total bytes divided by total milliseconds), computed with real (non-integer) division.
The overall average is the simple unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages, taken only over media types that have at least one track with Bytes > 10323804.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the size filter; Milliseconds is NOT NULL and assumed non-zero.

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaType, avg_bpms, avg_bpms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_overall FROM per_type WHERE avg_bpms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type)

assumptions.assumption: Per-media-type average is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds (not total bytes / total milliseconds), using real (non-integer) division.
The overall average is the simple unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages, only over media types that have at least one track above the size threshold.
Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId (names are assumed unique in practice).

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type average computed as ratio of sums (total Bytes / total Milliseconds) instead of mean of per-track ratios.
